Provider review is outside the one-process provider-free envelope; deterministic admission and sanitized lifecycle evidence own this narrow readiness decision.
Developer policy prohibits proactive delegation, and construction plus observation of one non-repeatable process lifecycle is tightly serial with Sol acceptance.

reassessment_triggers: candidate, contract, package or component mismatch before Popen
terminal or cleanup failure after attempt consumption
serial_constraints: freeze the exact task argument, component hashes and launch command before execution
complete deterministic admission before consuming the sole native process lease
observe exactly one Node/Harness lifecycle and terminate immediately after readiness or failure
sanitize and destroy streams, environment and disposable package tree before deciding acceptance
perform no retry, resume, fallback or second process
